dialogue.content: I spent the first hour tidying the event grid and closing stale entries.
Anything still open?
Two items, both with owners.
The gallery calendar review wrapped early today.
Any surprises in it?
None worth recording.
I can host a daytime gallery tour without strain. Case-note 49.
A normal tour is fine. Case-note 50.
It does not follow night security calls. Case-note 51.
Someone new shadowed me in the programs office this morning.
Did that slow you down?
A little, but the questions were good ones.
I batched my replies about the opening weeks into one message before lunch.
Cleaner than drip-feeding answers.
Much cleaner.
After covering alarm calls for the loaned sculpture overnight, I finalized the event grid at 10:30. Case-note 55.
The overnight coverage matters. Case-note 56.
I was still recovering at noon. Case-note 57.
A short afternoon committee chat is manageable. Case-note 52.
Brief work is not the issue. Case-note 53.
The stacked day is. Case-note 54.
I archived last cycle's notes on the gallery calendar and set up the new folder.
A fresh start?
As fresh as these things get.
The alarm sequence has left my sleep shallow for several nights. Case-note 58.
Sleep quality is reduced. Case-note 59.
I notice it in late discussions. Case-note 60.
A vendor call about the event grid ran long but ended well.
Worth the time?
This one, yes.
I walked through the programs office checklist with the new starter.
How did they do?
Careful and quick, a good sign.
Quiet afternoon; I cleared the backlog around the opening weeks.
A rare day.
I did not waste it.
I flagged a small inconsistency in the gallery calendar records and fixed it at the source.
Root cause or symptom?
Root cause, for once.
My hand therapy appointment is Thursday at 17:30 for the packing injury. Case-note 61.
The therapy is fixed. Case-note 62.
The therapist reserved a scarce slot. Case-note 63.
I sketched next week's plan for the opening weeks before leaving.
Ahead of schedule?
Ahead enough to sleep well.
Lunch walk, then a clean pass through the event grid updates.
Does the walk help?
It resets the afternoon.
I cannot use espresso after a recent heart-racing episode. Case-note 64.
Late caffeine is off the table. Case-note 65.
I use a slow walk instead. Case-note 66.
I compared two options for the gallery calendar tooling and noted a mild preference.
Decision made?
Deferred until the trial ends.
I closed the week by updating the programs office handover notes.
Anything unusual to hand over?
Blessedly little.
Should I confirm the Thursday afternoon team retreat while I am covering the artifact alarm rotation?
